The '''Cloud City Grand Prix''' was an annual [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] race held in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The race pitted speeder pilots from all over the galaxy against each other. The prize included money and VIP access to a grand gala and auction. The citizens of Cloud City were known to bet on the race.

==Behind the scenes==
The Cloud Car City Race was made especially for ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' campaign and introduces a dynamic set of racing rules.
